title: P200K worth of smuggled meat seized from Manila grocery stores
summary: Authorities confiscated over 650 kilograms of smuggled frozen meat products during joint operations at two Chinese grocery stores in Binondo and Sta. Ana, Manila on Monday night, October 12.
